name: tlctc
description: TLCTC (Top Level Cyber Threat Clusters) — a cause-oriented, axiomatic cyber threat taxonomy framework. See https://www.tlctc.net

scripts.validate: npm run validate-framework && npm run validate-attack-paths && npm run validate-consistency && npm run build-okf && npm run validate-okf
scripts.build-pdfs: node scripts/build-pdf.js documentation/tlctc-v2.5-core.md documentation/tlctc-v2.5-core.pdf && node scripts/build-pdf.js documentation/tlctc-v2.5-application.md documentation/tlctc-v2.5-application.pdf && node scripts/build-pdf.js documentation/tlctc-glossary.md documentation/tlctc-glossary.pdf

author: Bernhard Kreinz
